description: This file defines the 'HonoReceiver' class, which implements an AMQP network receiver for the Eclipse Hono project. It manages connection setup, message consumption, and statistical sampling for JMeter performance tests, utilizing the Hono client library to connect to Hono infrastructure and handle incoming messages asynchronously in a synchronous manner suitable for JMeter threading.

classes.name: HonoReceiver
classes.description: Implements a JMeter-compatible AMQP message receiver that connects to Hono infrastructure, consumes messages asynchronously, and gathers statistics for performance testing.

methods.name: HonoReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with configuration parameters and creating the ApplicationClientFactory.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Establishes connection to Hono and creates a message consumer, returning a CompletableFuture indicating success or failure.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Hono infrastructure asynchronously and logs the connection event.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates either a telemetry or event consumer based on endpoint, setting messageReceived as the message handler.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a JMeter SampleResult object from the collected message statistics.

methods.name: messageReceived
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, extracting sender time when configured, updating counters and timing info.

methods.name: setSampleStartIfNotSetYet
methods.description: Sets the initial sample start timestamp if it hasn't been set.

methods.name: getSenderTime
methods.description: Retrieves sender time from message, either from payload JSON or from message properties.

methods.name: getSenderTimeFromJsonPayload
methods.description: Parses JSON payload to extract sender time of message.

methods.name: getSenderTimeFromMessageProperties
methods.description: Extracts sender time from message application properties.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up resources.
